name: Mohamad Alhaddad
tagline: I build LLM agent systems and computer vision pipelines that run in production, not in notebooks.
about: Machine learning engineer with 7+ years building and shipping AI systems — LLM-powered multi-agent architectures, RAG pipelines, and real-time computer vision. I work end to end: model design, the async services around it, and the deployment that keeps it running.

Most recently at Innoscripta AG in Germany, building agentic extraction pipelines and document intelligence tooling over enterprise-scale knowledge graphs. Before that, real-time incident detection for tunnels, highways, and rail crossings in collaboration with Intel and Huawei.
Three peer-reviewed and preprint publications in computer vision and neural network dependability.

points: Built agentic AI pipelines extracting structured data from European enterprises, feeding a scalable knowledge graph built on NLP and deep learning models.
Led development of document intelligence tools — scanned invoice parser, email analyzer, timesheet parser — reaching 90%+ extraction accuracy.
Exposed LLM agents as async FastAPI services, with Docker deployments and CI/CD on AWS.
Designed a smart incident detection system for tunnels and highways with Intel, identifying incidents in real time on optimized models.
Built a 3D port container scanner integrating ML models to scan logistics containers, improving throughput and reducing error rates.
Developed a train crossing incident detection system with Huawei using object detection to improve intersection safety.

publications.title: Incident Detection on Junction Using Image Processing
Application of the Neural Network Dependability Kit in Real-World Environments
